Step: 1232 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception in Gregorian rules for that era).  
From 09-17 back 345 days:  
Go back 17 days to Sep 1 (16 days back to Sep 1? Actually 17 → Sep 1 is 16 days back, so Sep 1 is 09-01, 16 days back).  
345 total: 16 days accounted, 329 left.  
Aug (31) + Jul (31) + Jun (30) + May (31) + Apr (30) + Mar (31) + Feb (29, leap) + Jan (31) = 31+31+30+31+30+31+29+31 = 244 days back to Jan 1.  
329 - 244 = 85 days left into previous year (1231).  
1231 not leap, Dec 31 → back 85 days: Dec (31), Nov (30), Oct (31) = 92 days total from Dec 31 to Oct 1. Need 85 back, so from Dec 31 back 85 days = Dec 31 minus 85 = Dec 31 → back 31 days to Dec 1, 54 left → back 30 days to Nov 1, 24 left → back 24 days into October: Oct 31 → back 24 days = Oct 7.  
Thus date: 1231-10-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1231-10-07
